variables.name: WorkshopVersion
variables.note: Workshop package version. Keep this aligned with the imported assets.

variables.name: ParticipantId
variables.note: Three-digit participant identifier. Override in the active value set.

variables.name: EnvironmentName
variables.note: Logical environment label. This is not a Fabric workspace identifier.

variables.name: ExpectedWorkspaceName
variables.note: Optional fail-closed workspace display-name check for interactive notebooks.

variables.name: IncrementFileName
variables.note: Diagnostics and fallback only. The participant flow uses the OneLake FileCreated trigger, which supplies Subject; this value is read only by a manual Pipeline run outside that flow.

variables.name: StrictSyntheticContract
variables.note: Require the packaged deterministic row-count and duplicate-event contract.
